title: Qualify missing observations and bounded frequency-weighted descriptive statistics
commitMessage: feat: qualify frequency weighted statistics and close descriptive boundaries

contribution.summary: Qualify explicit Reject/Skip null policies and bounded positive integer-frequency descriptive statistics with a controlled RED, 23 independent GREEN tests and 44 statistics tests in total. Reuse Neumaier compensated summation, confirm Math.NET managed oracles, rational and numerical regressions and NuGet preview.2. Complete M3-W02-C01-T2 and C01 while preserving active M3-W02.
contribution.value: Make missingness and replication-count variance denominators explicit, refuse NaN, invalid weights, empty admitted data, oversized input and nonfinite intermediates; preserve exact and finite arithmetic as separate contracts.
debtChanges: Only positive integer repetition frequencies are admitted; continuous reliability/importance weights and their denominator conventions require separate qualification.
Missing means null only; default Reject requires explicit opt-in Skip. NaN and infinity always refuse and imputation is not claimed.
Source records and included frequency are each bounded at 4096. Overflowing weighted sums, deviations or variance never yield partial results.
RS044 exact rational unweighted statistics remain intact; new weighted calculations are explicitly approximate finite binary64.
Math.NET remains an independent managed test consumer, not a runtime dependency. No unobserved RID or native BLAS is admitted.
Quantiles, correlation and distributions remain future M3-W02 phases; closing C01 does not complete M3-W02.
No Decision/Aura mutation, dw.discovery agent skill, BrokerReady designation or public NuGet publication is authorized.
contribution.nextAction: After RS045 success, prepare M3-W02-C02 quantiles and correlation in the accepted DWF plan. Revisit neutral dw.discovery after independent package and Workflow qualification.

achievements.achievement: Observe and retain a compiled reflection RED for the missing frequency/nullable-policy API against the previously qualified statistics library.
Implement bounded positive integer-frequency weighted descriptive statistics and opt-in null Skip policy using shared compensated floating arithmetic.
Pass 23 focused GREEN cases, all 44 statistics tests, managed Math.NET corroboration, prior numeric and rational regressions, and local NuGet preview.2 structure.
Qualify missingness and frequency-weighted boundary semantics with explicit invalid-data, cardinality and finite-arithmetic refusals.
Complete both descriptive statistics tasks and scientific evidence while leaving M3-W02 active for remaining accepted statistical responsibilities.
